payload.passage: We make a big feast for the guests at festivals. We cook many tasty dishes for everyone to enjoy. Then all of us sit and eat together.
payload.title: We make a feast for guests

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Charu brings a box of dates. She passes it to her friends. They each take one sweet date.

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the children all get money. They feel very happy and excited about it. They run off to buy little toys with it.

payload.passage: On the green play field, Manu sees his friend feel sad. He gives him a kind hug. Soon his friend feels much better.

payload.passage: We do many happy things to celebrate Diwali. We wear new clothes and meet all our family. We also eat lots of sweet and tasty treats.

payload.passage: On the Holi festival we wear our old clothes. We know the bright colours will stay on them. But we do not mind that one little bit.

payload.passage: On a busy school day, it is craft day in the classroom. The children stick coloured paper on a chart. They make a big paper kite.

payload.title: We get treats on a birthday

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the teacher shows a real coconut in class. She lets the children touch it. They feel the rough brown shell.

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the class learns a song about the rain. They tap their feet to the beat. They make rain sounds with their hands.

payload.passage: Monkeys love to live high up in the trees. They swing from branch to branch with their long arms and tail. They like to eat sweet bananas with their tiny hands.

payload.passage: Diwali is the happy festival of lights. People light many small lamps all around their home. They also burst bright colourful crackers up in the night sky.

payload.title: A festival is full of love

payload.title: On Holi everyone is welcome

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we say sorry to people. We make peace with everyone we know. We happily start the new year fresh and clean.
payload.title: We make peace on Diwali

payload.passage: Sunflowers are big yellow flowers that love the sun. They slowly turn to follow the sun across the sky. They are tall and bright and stand up high in the field.

payload.passage: During the school hours, Diya learns to draw a star. She makes five neat points. She colours it bright yellow with great care.

payload.passage: On our birthday we get many lovely gifts. We open each one with great joy and excitement. Then we say a big thank you to everyone.
payload.title: We get gifts on a birthday

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Misha brings a bowl of cut mango. She adds a pinch of salt. She shares it with her friends.
payload.title: Misha shares salted mango

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we boil fresh milk. We watch it rise high up in the new pot. We all shout out with great joy when it boils over.
payload.title: On Pongal we boil milk
decoys: The milk rises in the pot

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Mohit brings sweets on his birthday. He gives one to each friend. He keeps a few for the teachers.
payload.title: Mohit shares birthday sweets

payload.passage: Owls like to stay wide awake all through the night. They have big round eyes that help them see in the dark. They sleep in the trees during the bright daytime.
payload.title: Owls stay awake at night

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we feel very thankful. We thank the warm sun and the falling rain. They both help our crops to grow big.
payload.title: On Pongal we feel thankful

payload.passage: Crabs are clever animals that can grow a new claw. If one of their claws breaks off, a new one grows back. But it takes quite some time for it to grow.
payload.title: Crabs grow a new claw

payload.passage: When the day begins, Maya keeps her crayons in a tin box. She has red, blue, and green ones. She lets her friend use them too.
payload.title: Maya's box of crayons

payload.passage: A pup is the little baby of a seal. It is born on the cold white ice near the sea. Soon it learns how to swim in the cool water.
payload.title: A baby seal is a pup
decoys: It is born on the ice

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Riya has a big box of crayons. Her friend Sam has only one. Riya shares her crayons so they can both colour.
payload.title: Riya shares her crayons

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we wear soft new clothes. The brand new clothes feel very nice on us. We all look very fine and smart in them.
payload.title: On Eid we wear soft new clothes

payload.passage: On Eid the new moon in the sky is special. People look up carefully into the evening sky. When they spot the thin moon, the festival begins.
payload.title: The moon starts the Eid festival

payload.passage: A festival is a happy time meant for everyone. Both rich and poor people all join in the fun. We happily share whatever good things we have.
payload.title: A festival is for everyone

payload.passage: When the day begins, the school has a flag in the yard. Every morning the children salute it. They feel proud of their country.
payload.title: Saluting the school flag
decoys: The flag is in the yard

payload.passage: Fish live deep down in the cool water. They swim all day long by moving their thin fins from side to side. They breathe under the water and not in the air like us.
payload.title: Fish live in the water

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, two friends share one big sheet. One paints a tree, one paints a bird. They make one bright scene.
payload.title: Friends share a big sheet

payload.passage: A baby bird slowly grows its feathers as it gets big. At first its body is covered in soft little fluff. Then strong feathers come in so it can fly.
payload.title: A baby bird grows feathers

payload.passage: Our grandparents love to tell us nice stories. They tell these special stories on the festival days. The stories teach us many good and kind things.
payload.title: Grandparents tell festival stories

payload.passage: Wolves are animals that live together in a big group. The group they live in is called a pack. They howl loud at night when they look up at the moon.
payload.title: Wolves live in a pack

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Sohan sees a friend sitting alone. He goes and sits with him. Soon they laugh and play a game.
payload.title: Sohan sits with a lonely friend

payload.passage: Jellyfish are soft animals that float in the sea. Their round body feels soft and wobbly like jelly. They have long thin arms that hang down in the water.
payload.title: Jellyfish float in the sea

payload.passage: Summer days are very long and very hot. The bright sun stays up high in the sky for many hours. We love to rest in the shade and drink cool water.
payload.title: Summer days are hot

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Vivaan keeps the class door open in summer. The cool breeze comes inside. The children feel fresh and happy.
payload.title: Vivaan opens the class door

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, Zoya draws a butterfly in art. She gives it big wings. She fills them with bright spots before the next class.
payload.title: Zoya draws a butterfly

payload.passage: An owlet is the little baby of an owl. It is covered in soft fluffy white feathers. It waits quietly in the nest for its mother to bring food.
payload.title: A baby owl is an owlet

payload.passage: On the green play field, Anu draws a nice card. She gives it to her best friend. The card says, You are my best friend.
payload.title: Anu gives a card to her friend

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Bina helps the teacher carry the books. The pile is tall and a bit heavy. She puts them on the big desk.
payload.title: Bina helps carry the books

payload.passage: Out in the playground, a friend slips in the mud. His friend pulls him up. He helps wipe the mud off his shoe.
payload.title: A friend helps after a slip

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one story book. They sit close on the mat. They turn each page together out in the playground.
payload.title: Friends share a story book

payload.passage: We light many little lamps all over at night. Soon the whole house begins to glow with light. It looks just like a pretty fairy land.
payload.title: Lamps make the house glow

payload.passage: Zebras are animals with black and white stripes. They run fast on the wide open grass to stay safe. They live together with many others in a big group.
payload.title: Zebras have black stripes

payload.passage: Festivals teach us the good habit of sharing. We give things to people who are in need. In this way we slowly learn to be kind.
payload.title: A festival teaches us to share
decoys: We give to those in need

payload.passage: On the Holi festival our grandmother joins in too. She happily throws the bright colours at us. She laughs and plays along with all of us.
payload.title: Grandmother joins in on Holi

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one football. They pass it to and fro. They laugh as they play as good friends do.
payload.title: Friends share a football

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, two friends share one swing turn count. They count to ten each. Then they swap with a smile.
payload.title: Friends count swing turns

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we forgive other people. We happily let go of any old fights. Then we smile at them and move on together.
payload.title: On Eid we forgive others

payload.passage: High up in the mountains the air is fresh and cold. It is so thin up there that it is hard to breathe. Many animals like goats and bears live on the mountains.
payload.title: Mountains have fresh cold air
decoys: The air is hard to breathe

payload.passage: At a party we play many fun little games. The people who win get to take home small prizes. After that we all dance to happy music together.
payload.title: We play games at a party

payload.passage: We send pretty cards to people on special days. We carefully write kind and loving words inside them. The lovely cards make everyone smile with joy.
payload.title: We give cards on special days

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children clean their classroom. They pick up the paper bits. They put the chairs in a neat row.
payload.title: Children clean their classroom

payload.passage: While they play together, two girls share one pot of glue. One sticks paper, one sticks string. They make one big card.
payload.title: Friends share the glue

payload.passage: A piglet is the little baby of a pig. It is small and soft and pink in colour. It stays close to its mother on the muddy farm.
payload.title: A baby pig is a piglet

payload.passage: A festival fills the whole air with happy sound. We hear ringing bells and beating drums all day. We also hear children laughing and playing.
payload.title: A festival fills the air with sound

payload.passage: Worms are little animals that wiggle in the wet mud. They have a long soft body and no legs at all. Hungry birds love to dig them up and eat them.
payload.title: Worms wiggle in the mud

payload.passage: Dolphins are clever and friendly animals of the sea. They jump up high out of the water and splash back down. They are very playful and love to swim together.
payload.title: Dolphins are friendly sea animals

payload.passage: Most kinds of snakes lay eggs to have their babies. The eggs have a soft bendy shell, not a hard one. After some time the baby snakes hatch out of them.
payload.title: Most snakes lay eggs

payload.passage: On Eid we cook a big and tasty feast. We make many sweet and warm dishes to share. We sit and eat the feast with all our family.
payload.title: On Eid we cook a big feast

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children plant a tiny seed in a pot. They add soil and water it. They hope a plant will grow soon.
payload.title: The class plants a seed

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend's shoe lace comes off. His friend ties it back. He pulls it tight and neat near the school gate.
payload.title: A friend ties a loose lace

payload.passage: During the school hours, Hari learns to skip with a rope. At first the rope hits his feet. After some tries, he skips ten times.
payload.title: Hari learns to skip

payload.passage: Giraffes are the tallest animals in the whole world. They have a very long neck and long thin legs. They use the long neck to eat green leaves at the top of trees.
payload.title: Giraffes are the tallest animals

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls find a baby bird. They make a soft nest for it. They keep it safe till its mother comes.
payload.title: Friends help a baby bird

payload.passage: A festival is a happy time of fun for all. Both old people and young children join in. Nobody at all is ever left out of the fun.
payload.title: A festival is fun for all

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, a friend cannot find his shoe. His friend looks under the bench. He finds it and gives it back.
payload.title: A friend finds the lost shoe

payload.passage: Every festival is full of bright happy colours. We see the lovely colours all around us. The bright colours make us smile with joy.
payload.title: A festival has bright colours

payload.passage: Early in the day, the teacher shows a real lemon in class. She lets the children smell it. They say it smells fresh and sour.
payload.title: Smelling a lemon in class

payload.passage: Some frogs have very bright and colourful skin. These bright colours warn other animals to keep away. They tell the other animals that the frog is not safe to eat.
payload.title: Bright frogs warn other animals

payload.passage: Foxes are clever animals with a long bushy tail. They have soft fur that is red and brown in colour. They are quick on their feet and good at hiding.
payload.title: Foxes are clever animals

payload.passage: We share our sweets with the whole street at festivals. We knock on each door to give the sweets. Everyone smiles back at us with happy faces.
payload.title: We share sweets with the street

payload.passage: Our elders give us their blessings on festivals. The older people gently bless all the children. The happy children feel loved and very glad.
payload.title: Elders give blessings on festivals

payload.passage: We blow loudly on a horn at the new year. We shout and cheer happily all together. Then we hug all of our dear friends.
payload.title: We cheer at the new year

payload.passage: While they play together, Devi has a jar of sweets. She does not eat them all. She shares them with the whole class.
payload.title: Devi shares with the class

payload.passage: On the green play field, Bharat sees a friend with no pencil. He breaks his pencil in two. He gives one half to his friend.
payload.title: Bharat shares his pencil

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend cannot reach the swing rope. His friend holds it low for him. He grabs it and sits down.
payload.title: A friend lowers the swing rope

payload.passage: During their free time, Gita has a bag of popcorn. She brings it to the playground. She shares it with all her friends.
payload.title: Gita shares her popcorn

payload.passage: Rivers carry fresh clean water across the land. The cool water flows along fast over the rocks and stones. Many fish and frogs make their home in the river.
payload.title: Rivers carry fresh water

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, it is the last day before holidays. The children sing and play happily. They wish each other a fun break.
payload.title: The last day before holidays

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Pinky drops her pencils on the floor. Her friend bends down to help. Together they pick up every pencil.
payload.title: A friend helps pick up pencils

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two friends share one big drum. One taps, then the other taps. They make a steady beat without any fuss.
payload.title: Friends share a drum

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Sahil brings a box of toffees. He counts one for each friend. He hands them out at lunch.
payload.title: Sahil shares his toffees

payload.passage: Bees are small but very busy insects. They fly from flower to flower all day long to gather food. They use it to make sweet golden honey for us to eat.
payload.title: Bees are busy and make honey

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the teacher hands out new notebooks. Each one has a blue cover. The children write their names on them.
payload.title: New notebooks for the class

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot do up his buttons. His friend helps him do them. He buttons the shirt to the top.
payload.title: A friend helps with buttons

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we kindly feed the birds. We put out little grains on the ground for them. The hungry birds fly down and come to eat.
payload.title: On Pongal we feed the birds

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the streets are very full. So many people come out of their homes to play. The whole town is loud and full of colour.
payload.title: The streets are full on Holi

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Myra draws a big fish on paper. She gives it round eyes and fins. She colours it bright orange.
payload.title: Myra draws a fish

payload.passage: A spider's web can catch tiny drops of water. After the rain the whole web shines in the light. The drops on the thread look just like little beads.
payload.title: A spider's web catches rain drops

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we burst small crackers. Some little ones spin round and round on the ground. They throw out many tiny bright sparks.
payload.title: We burst small crackers on Diwali

payload.passage: A fawn is the little baby of a deer. It has soft white spots all over its brown coat. The spots help the fawn hide safely in the long grass.
payload.title: A baby deer is a fawn

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Dhruv learns to draw a house today. He makes a roof and a door. He adds two small windows too.
payload.title: Dhruv draws a house

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Amit falls down while running. His friend Raj helps him stand up. Raj walks with him to the bench.
payload.title: Raj helps his friend up

payload.passage: When the day begins, Reyansh draws a tall tree in art. He adds green leaves on top. He puts a bird on a branch.
payload.title: Reyansh draws a tree

payload.passage: Acorns are little brown nuts that grow on oak trees. Busy squirrels gather up many of them in autumn. They store the acorns to eat in the cold winter.
payload.title: Acorns grow on oak trees

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the teacher tells the children to line up. They walk in a long line. They go to see the school garden.
payload.title: Lining up for the garden

payload.passage: A baby cow learns to eat grass as it grows up. At first it only drinks warm milk from its mother. Slowly it learns to chew the soft green grass too.
payload.title: A baby cow learns to eat grass

payload.passage: A calf is the baby of a cow. It drinks warm milk from its mother every day. It stays close by her side out in the green field.
payload.title: A calf is a baby cow

payload.passage: Bears are big animals with thick brown fur. They love to find and eat sweet sticky honey. They sleep in a warm cave all through the cold winter.
payload.title: Bears are big furry animals

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one new pen. They write on the same page. They take turns very nicely during the lunch break.
payload.title: Friends share a new pen

payload.passage: While they play together, two girls share one tin of clips. One picks red, one picks blue. They clip their papers neatly.
payload.title: Friends share a tin of clips

payload.passage: On the green play field, Hridaan has a bag of sweets and nuts. He brings it on a trip. He shares it with his friends.
payload.title: Hridaan shares sweets and nuts

payload.passage: After the first bell, today the class learns about animals. The teacher shows pictures of a cow and a goat. Everyone learns the sounds they make.
payload.title: The class learns about animals
decoys: There is a picture of a goat

payload.passage: Most cats can see very well in the dark night. Their special eyes catch even the tiniest bit of light. This good night sight helps them hunt for food.
payload.title: Cats see well at night

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend feels too hot at play. His friend shares his cool water. He drinks and feels fresh.
payload.title: A friend shares cool water

payload.passage: Fog is a thick white mist that fills the air. It floats low and hides the road from us in the morning. It is hard to see very far ahead in the fog.
payload.title: Fog is a thick mist

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Disha shares her tiffin with a friend. Her friend forgot his snack. They eat the puri together.
payload.title: Disha shares her tiffin

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the teacher draws shapes on the board. She makes a circle and a square. The children name each shape.
payload.title: Learning shapes in class

payload.passage: We thank god on our festival days. We all pray together quietly with our family. After praying we feel very calm and peaceful inside.
payload.title: We thank god at festivals

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, the teacher shows a clock with hands. She moves the hands to nine. She says it is time for class.
payload.title: Learning time on a clock

payload.passage: Early in the day, the class learns about a milkman. The teacher shows a milk can. She says he brings milk each morning.
payload.title: Learning about a milkman

payload.passage: We feel lots of joy on festival days. We forget all our little worries for a while. We just smile and feel happy all day long.
payload.title: We feel joy at festivals

payload.passage: Whales are the biggest animals in the whole sea. They live deep down in the cool blue sea water. They swim up to the top now and then to take in fresh air.
payload.title: Whales are huge sea animals

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Pooja keeps her desk very tidy. Her books are in a neat row. Her pencil box sits in one corner.
payload.title: Pooja keeps her desk tidy
decoys: Her books are in a row

payload.passage: A beehive is the cosy home where bees live. It is full of many tiny six-sided rooms inside. The busy bees store all their sweet honey in the rooms.
payload.title: A beehive is the bees' home

payload.passage: We all sing for the birthday child at the party. Everyone says a loud and happy birthday together. Then we all clap our hands with great joy.
payload.title: We sing for the birthday child

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, Anaya reads a chart of farm animals. She points to a cow and a pig. She says each animal's name aloud.
payload.title: Anaya reads the animal chart

payload.passage: When the day begins, Tanvi learns to stand on one leg. The teacher counts to five. Tanvi stays still and does not fall.
payload.title: Tanvi balances on one leg

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, today the teacher tells a story about a lion. The lion was strong but kind. The children love the tale.
payload.title: A story about a kind lion

payload.passage: We hold hands and dance together at festivals. We move round and round in a big happy ring. We laugh and twirl along with all our friends.
payload.title: We hold hands and dance at festivals

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend is new and feels lost. Two girls take his hand. They show him the whole school.
payload.title: Friends show a new boy around

payload.passage: On the Eid festival the cooked food smells lovely. The warm smell fills up the whole house. It makes all of us feel very hungry.
payload.title: On Eid the food smells nice

payload.passage: While they play together, Veena bakes a small cake. She brings it to her friend. They cut it and eat together out in the playground.
payload.title: Veena shares her cake

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two girls find one slice of cake. They want to be fair. They cut it into two equal parts.
payload.title: Friends split a slice of cake

payload.passage: The Pongal festival goes on for many happy days. People draw pretty patterns on the floor each morning. They cook special food outside in the open sun.
payload.title: Pongal lasts for many days

payload.passage: The sea is very big and looks bright blue. Its water is salty and not at all sweet like a drink. Big heavy ships sail across the top of the wide sea.
payload.title: The sea is big and blue

payload.passage: We give a small gift to each of our guests. We wrap up each little gift very nicely. They smile with joy when they open them.
payload.title: We give a small gift to each guest

payload.passage: While they play together, Tina has a new ball to play. She asks her friend to join. They throw and catch the ball together.
payload.title: Tina plays with her friend

payload.passage: A festival makes all of us feel very glad. We sing happy songs and dance about. We forget all our sad and worried thoughts.
payload.title: A festival makes us all glad

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we use a brand new pot. We boil the fresh milk in the new pot. We let it spill over for good luck.
payload.title: We use a new pot on Pongal

payload.passage: A baby cat is born with its eyes shut tight. It cannot see anything at all in the first few days. After about a week it slowly opens its eyes.
payload.title: A kitten opens its eyes late
decoys: Its eyes are shut at birth

payload.passage: After the first bell, the class learns about the sun and moon. The teacher shows a big bright sun. She says the moon comes at night.
payload.title: Learning about the sun and moon

payload.passage: On the Holi festival our pet dog hides away. The bright colours and loud noise scare the dog. It only comes back out when we all stop.
payload.title: The dog hides away on Holi

payload.passage: On Diwali we eat our dinner quite late at night. The whole family sits down together to eat. We happily share many tasty dishes between us.
payload.title: We eat a big dinner on Diwali

payload.passage: After the first bell, the children learn to fold a napkin. The teacher shows a neat square. Each child folds one on the desk.
payload.title: Learning to fold a napkin

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Ojas has a bag of apples. He brings them after the game. He gives one to each tired friend.
payload.title: Ojas shares his apples

payload.passage: We light the lamps slowly one after the other. We light the first one and then all the rest. Soon the whole room fills up with warm light.
payload.title: We light lamps one by one

payload.passage: Tiny seeds can grow into big healthy plants. We push a small seed gently down into the soft soil. With enough water and sunlight it slowly starts to grow.
payload.title: Seeds grow into plants

payload.passage: We light a little lamp for our home on festivals. We pray for many good and happy days. We hope for lots of joy in the home.
payload.title: We light a lamp for our home
decoys: We light it for the home

payload.passage: We blow up lots of balloons for the party. We carefully tie them up along the wall. Soon the whole room looks bright and cheerful.
payload.title: We blow up balloons for the party
decoys: We tie them to the wall

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we paint the cooking pot. We tie a fresh green leaf around the top. We do all this to make the pot look pretty.
payload.title: On Pongal we paint the pot
decoys: We tie a leaf on top

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot open his bottle. His friend twists the cap for him. Now he can drink his water.
payload.title: A friend opens a tight bottle

payload.passage: We put up colourful flags for a festival. The pretty flags wave gently in the wind. They make the whole street look bright and cheerful.
payload.title: We put up flags for festivals

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Aria reads a story to the small kids. She shows them the bright pictures. They sit and listen with care.
payload.title: Aria reads to the little ones

payload.passage: On Diwali we paint pretty designs on our hands. We use a special paste to make the design. The lovely design dries to a dark red colour.
payload.title: We paint our hands on Diwali

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, two friends share one bench. They sit close and read. They point to the words together during the lunch break.
payload.title: Friends share one bench

payload.passage: Kangaroos are animals that can jump very far. They live in a faraway land across the sea. The tiny baby stays safe inside the mother's warm pouch.
payload.title: Kangaroos jump very far

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the school has a big sports field. Children play cricket near the trees. The ground is full of soft green grass.
payload.title: The big school sports field

payload.passage: Parrots are pretty birds with bright colourful feathers. They have a strong curved beak to crack open hard nuts and seeds. Some clever parrots can even copy what people say.
payload.title: Parrots are colourful birds

payload.passage: Tigers are big and strong wild cats. They have bright orange fur with black stripes all over the body. They quietly hunt for their food in the thick green forest.
payload.title: Tigers are big wild cats

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival the cows look very pretty. We paint their long horns in bright colours. We also tie pretty flowers around their necks.
payload.title: On Pongal cows look pretty

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls find a lost puppy. They give it some milk. They keep it warm till it is found.
payload.title: Friends help a lost puppy

payload.passage: During the lunch break, Tia brings a basket of plums. She sets it down at break. She shares them with the group.
payload.title: Tia shares her plums

payload.passage: During the lunch break, a friend feels scared of the dark room. His friend holds his hand. Together they walk in slowly.
payload.title: A friend helps in the dark

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, two boys want the same kite. They decide to share it. One holds the string, one runs along.
payload.title: Friends share a kite

payload.passage: A frog begins its life inside a small egg. When it hatches out, it is a little tadpole with a tail. Slowly it grows legs and turns into a frog.
payload.title: A frog grows from an egg

payload.passage: On a busy school day, the class learns to skip in a line. The teacher leads the way. The children skip behind her.
payload.title: Skipping in a line

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two girls share one big notebook. One writes on the front, one on the back. They keep it very neat.
payload.title: Friends share a notebook

payload.passage: At the busy school, Reyan has a bowl of cut fruit. He brings it to share. He gives a spoon to each friend.
payload.title: Reyan shares his cut fruit

payload.passage: During the lunch break, two friends find one red apple. They want to be fair. So they cut it into two halves and eat together.
payload.title: Two friends share an apple

payload.passage: Plants are very useful because they give out fresh air. They make this clean air using sunlight and their green leaves. We breathe in this air, so plants help us live.
payload.title: Plants give us fresh air

payload.passage: Early in the day, Ananya keeps a small plant on her desk. She gives it a little water. She talks to it every day.
payload.title: Ananya cares for her plant

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend trips on the stairs. His friend catches his arm. He helps him stand up slowly.
payload.title: A friend catches a falling boy

payload.passage: We wear fresh flowers in our hair for festivals. We pin the pretty flowers up on special days. The lovely flowers smell very sweet and nice.
payload.title: We wear flowers for festivals
decoys: We wear them in our hair
We do it on special days

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we share with the poor. We give them food and a little money. Helping them makes us feel happy and good inside.
payload.title: On Eid we share with the poor

payload.passage: A baby goat loves to skip and play all day. It jumps high up in the air just for fun. It is full of joy and runs around the farm.
payload.title: A baby goat loves to play

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the class learns to clap a beat. The teacher claps slow then fast. The children copy her beat.
payload.title: Clapping a beat in class

payload.passage: On a busy school day, Yash sweeps the leaves in the school yard. He uses a long broom. He makes a small pile near the tree.
payload.title: Yash sweeps the school yard

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the school has a small fish tank. The children watch the orange fish swim. They feed it tiny bits of food.
payload.title: The class watches the fish

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one box of sweets. They count them out fair. Each one gets the same number.
payload.title: Friends share sweets fairly

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend cannot carry his heavy bag. His friend takes one strap. They carry it together with a big smile.
payload.title: Friends carry a heavy bag

payload.passage: A cactus is a plant that grows in the dry desert. It can store a lot of water inside its thick stem. It is covered all over with sharp little spines.
payload.title: A cactus grows in the desert

payload.passage: On the Pongal festival we share sweet rice. We happily give the tasty rice to our friends. We sit down and eat it together with love.
payload.title: On Pongal we share sweet rice
