payload.passage: Plants need three things to grow up healthy. They need clean air and fresh water from the soil. They also need bright light from the warm sun each day.
payload.title: Plants need air, water, and sun

payload.passage: Dragonflies are insects with thin shiny wings. They fly very fast near the cool green pond. They have very big round eyes to help them see.
payload.title: Dragonflies fly near the pond

payload.passage: While they play together, a friend cannot open the door. His friend pushes it with him. The door opens wide with a big smile.
payload.title: Friends push the door open

payload.passage: A festival is a happy time meant for giving. We give lovely gifts and tasty food to others. Giving to people makes us feel good inside.
payload.title: A festival is a time to give

payload.passage: Early in the day, Sana watches the rain from the class window. The drops slide down the glass. She watches until the bell rings.
payload.title: Sana watches the rain

payload.passage: In the bright morning, Nira draws her school building. She makes a big gate. She adds a flag on top while the teacher watches.
payload.title: Nira draws her school

payload.passage: A nest full of eggs stays nice and warm. The mother bird sits gently on top of them every day. Soon the eggs crack open and little chicks come out.
payload.title: Eggs hatch into chicks

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, Tej brings a fresh guava. He cuts it into slices. He shares the slices with his friends without any fuss.
payload.title: Tej shares his guava

payload.passage: On the green play field, a friend cannot reach the high swing. His friend gives him a leg up. Now he sits on the swing.
payload.title: A friend gives a leg up

payload.passage: At the busy school, two friends share one box of shells. They count them on the desk. They split them into two piles.
payload.title: Friends share a box of shells

payload.passage: Pandas are black and white animals that eat bamboo. They munch on the green bamboo for most of the day. They live in cool hills that are very far away.
payload.title: Pandas eat green bamboo

payload.passage: During their free time, Mira brings a basket of pears. She gives one to each friend. They eat them by the gate.
payload.title: Mira shares her pears

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, Lalit sees a friend forget his cap. The sun is very hot. Lalit shares his cap on the way back.
payload.title: Lalit shares his cap

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Heena brings a juicy orange. She splits it into parts. She gives a piece to each friend.
payload.title: Heena shares her orange

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, Sita brings a shiny new schoolbag. It is red with a star on it. She keeps her books neatly inside it.
payload.title: Sita's new red schoolbag

payload.passage: Early in the day, the class watches a puppet show today. The puppets are a cat and a mouse. The children laugh at their funny talk.
payload.title: A puppet show in class

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the whole town joins in. People come out and play on every street. The streets are full of colour and joy.
payload.title: The whole town joins on Holi

payload.passage: A spider is a little animal that has eight legs. It walks slowly on the wall and across the floor. It spins a thin sticky web to catch its food.
payload.title: A spider has eight legs

payload.passage: Inside the cheerful classroom, the children make a noise board for class. They tap a drum and ring a bell. They learn loud and soft sounds.
payload.title: Making sounds in class

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, Parth has a bowl of grapes and figs. He sets it on the mat. He shares the fruit with his group.
payload.title: Parth shares his fruit bowl

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, the teacher asks a question in class. Many hands go up in the air. Anita gives the right answer and smiles.
payload.title: Anita answers the teacher

payload.passage: Out in the playground, two friends build a sand tower. One brings water, one shapes the sand. They make it tall together.
payload.title: Friends build a sand tower

payload.passage: When the bell rings for break, a friend cannot find his way home. His friend walks with him. He shows him the right road.
payload.title: A friend shows the way home

payload.passage: On a busy school day, the teacher shows seeds of many kinds. There are big and small ones. The children sort them into groups.
payload.title: Sorting seeds in class

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend feels sick in class. His friend tells the teacher. He helps him to the sick room.
payload.title: A friend helps a sick boy

payload.passage: At the busy school, a friend cannot zip his bag. His friend pulls the zip up. The bag is shut now on the green field.
payload.title: A friend zips up the bag

payload.passage: Hens give us fresh eggs to eat each day. They live happily together in a small wooden hen house. They peck at the ground with their beaks to find food.
payload.title: Hens give us eggs

payload.passage: On a fresh new day, Sunil is the helper today. He hands out the books to everyone. He also wipes the board for the teacher.
payload.title: Sunil is the class helper

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we hug everyone we meet. We warmly say a happy Eid to each one. Our hearts feel so full of love and joy.
payload.title: On Eid we hug everyone

payload.passage: Holi is the joyful festival of bright colours. People throw red, green and blue powder on each other. They laugh and run and play happily together.
payload.title: Holi is the festival of colours
decoys: The powder is red and blue

payload.passage: We sing happy songs together at our festivals. The whole family joins in and sings as one. It makes us all feel warm and very happy.
payload.title: We sing songs at festivals

payload.passage: Crows are clever birds that are black all over. They say caw caw loudly all through the day. They are smart and find their food very fast.
payload.title: Crows are clever black birds

payload.passage: Snakes have a long thin body and no legs at all. They cannot walk or run like other animals can. They slide along the ground to move from place to place.
payload.title: Snakes have no legs

payload.passage: On Pongal we thank the cows for their help. We give the cows a nice clean bath. Then we tie little bells on their horns.
payload.title: On Pongal we thank the cows

payload.passage: On a bright sunny day, two girls share one packet of straws. They use them for a craft. They make a long paper chain.
payload.title: Friends share straws for craft

payload.passage: On a sunny morning, the teacher shows a map of India. She points to the rivers and hills. The children look at it with big eyes.
payload.title: Looking at a map of India

payload.passage: Early in the day, Aman wins the running race at school. He gets a blue ribbon for it. He pins it on his shirt with pride.
payload.title: Aman wins the running race
decoys: He pins it on his shirt

payload.passage: On Diwali night the whole sky looks bright. Colourful crackers light it up high in the dark. The bright sparks look just like stars falling down.
payload.title: The sky is bright on Diwali

payload.passage: The day a new baby comes is a very happy one. The whole family comes together to meet the baby. They all bring lovely little gifts for the baby.
payload.title: A new baby is a happy day
decoys: The gifts are for the baby

payload.passage: Spiders make pretty webs out of thin silk thread. The web feels sticky and is much stronger than it looks. Small flying insects get stuck in the web.
payload.title: Spiders make sticky webs

payload.passage: At a birthday party we get to eat yummy cake. The cake is soft and sweet and tastes lovely. Each of us takes a nice big slice to eat.
payload.title: We eat cake at a party

payload.passage: On the green play field, two friends share one box of chalk sticks. They draw on the ground. They make a long hopscotch.
payload.title: Friends share chalk to draw

payload.passage: A festival is a time that brings people close. Our whole family comes from places far away. They all sit down together and eat a big meal.
payload.title: A festival brings people close

payload.passage: At a wedding there is lots of good food to eat. There is happy music and people dance all night. Everyone there is smiling and feeling very happy.
payload.title: A wedding has food and dancing

payload.passage: During the school hours, Tarun spills water on his desk. His friend gives him a cloth. Together they wipe the desk clean.
payload.title: Friends clean a spill

payload.passage: We happily share our food with others at festivals. We feed the hungry people who have less than us. Sharing the food makes them smile with joy.
payload.title: We share our food on festivals

payload.passage: On the Diwali festival we draw patterns with chalk. We make one big and pretty pattern on the ground. It looks bright and lovely when it is done.
payload.title: We draw patterns on Diwali

payload.passage: A garden is full of pretty bright flowers. Red, yellow and pink ones bloom there in the warm sun. Busy bees and colourful butterflies come to visit the flowers.
payload.title: A garden is full of flowers

payload.passage: During the school hours, the teacher gives gold stars for good work. Tina gets one star on her page. She runs home to show her mother.
payload.title: Tina earns a gold star

payload.passage: A joey is the tiny baby of a kangaroo. It is very small and weak when it is first born. It stays safe and warm inside its mother's pouch.
payload.title: A baby kangaroo is a joey
decoys: The joey stays in a pouch

payload.passage: A festival is a lovely day of rest for us. We do not have to go to school that day. Instead we play and have lots of fun.
payload.title: A festival is a day of rest
decoys: We do not go to school

payload.passage: On the Holi festival the children all run wild. They chase each other around with bright colour. They scream and laugh with great joy.
payload.title: Kids run wild on Holi

payload.passage: Ants leave a tiny smell trail on the ground as they walk. Other ants from the nest follow this little trail. The trail leads all of them straight to the food.
payload.title: Ants follow a scent trail

payload.passage: Bees, ants and flies are all kinds of insects. Every one of them has six legs on its body. Their little body is also split into three parts.
payload.title: Insects have six legs

payload.passage: A coconut tree gives us so many useful things. We can drink the sweet water from inside the coconut. We can also eat the soft white part inside it.
payload.title: A coconut tree gives us a lot

payload.passage: Out in the playground, Vedant has a packet of raisins. He opens it at the break. He shares a handful with friends.
payload.title: Vedant shares his raisins

payload.passage: Near the big school gate, Suman brings a box of dates and nuts. She mixes them in a bowl. She shares the mix with friends.
payload.title: Suman shares dates and nuts

payload.passage: A festival is a very happy and joyful time. People smile a lot and feel light and glad. Everyone comes together and has lots of fun.
payload.title: A festival is a happy time

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the teacher gives homework for the weekend. She asks the children to draw a tree. They write the date on top.
payload.title: Homework for the weekend

payload.passage: Octopuses are soft animals that live in the sea. They have eight long bendy arms that wave in the water. They squirt out black ink to hide from danger.
payload.title: Octopuses have eight arms

payload.passage: If we look at a leaf we can see tiny lines on it. These little lines are called the veins of the leaf. They carry water all around inside the leaf.
payload.title: A leaf has tiny veins

payload.passage: On Holi our clothes turn bright red and pink. The wet colour seems to go everywhere on us. We happily wash all the colour off later.
payload.title: Our clothes turn red on Holi

payload.passage: On a happy afternoon, a friend cannot hold all his books. His friend takes a few. They walk to class side by side.
payload.title: Friends share the books to carry

payload.passage: We give thanks for our food at harvest time. We feel very glad and lucky to have it. We happily share the food with everyone around us.
payload.title: We give thanks at the harvest

payload.passage: Soft white snow falls down in the cold winter. It covers the whole ground in a thick white blanket. Children love to play and make a snowman with it.
payload.title: Snow falls in winter

payload.passage: Cats are soft and very clean animals. They lick their own fur many times a day to stay neat and tidy. They also love to sleep a lot in the warm sun.
payload.title: Cats are clean animals

payload.passage: We make our home look pretty for the guests. We put fresh flowers all around the rooms. Soon the whole home smells lovely and sweet.
payload.title: We make our home pretty for guests

payload.passage: Pelicans are big water birds with a large beak. The bottom of the beak stretches out like a stretchy bag. They dip down and scoop up fish to eat.
payload.title: Pelicans scoop up fish

payload.passage: During their free time, two girls share one box of crayons and chalk. They draw on paper and the board. They make two bright pictures.
payload.title: Friends share crayons and chalk

payload.passage: A pond is a small place that is full of life. Fish, frogs and ducks all live happily in the water. Tall green plants grow along the muddy edge.
payload.title: A pond is full of life

payload.passage: Soon after assembly, Karan brings his story book to school. He shows the bright pictures to his friends. They all look at the pages together.
payload.title: Karan shares his story book

payload.passage: Crabs are little animals that live on the sandy beach. They walk in a funny way, moving sideways on the sand. They have two strong claws to catch their food.
payload.title: Crabs live on the beach

payload.passage: During their free time, Asmi brings a bowl of berries. She places it on the table. She shares the berries with her friends.
payload.title: Asmi shares her berries
decoys: She puts them on the table

payload.passage: In the bright morning, the school bell rings for the break. The children rush out with their snacks. They sit under a shady tree.
payload.title: The break time at school

payload.passage: On the Eid festival we make many sweet dishes. The tasty dishes are warm and soft and lovely. We happily give them to all our friends.
payload.title: On Eid we make sweet dishes

payload.passage: Ladybirds are tiny little bugs that are bright red. They have small round black spots all over their back. They like to sit and rest on soft green leaves.
payload.title: Ladybirds are tiny red bugs

payload.passage: On the green play field, two boys share one drawing book. One draws on a page, one on the next. They show the pages around.
payload.title: Friends share a drawing book

payload.passage: After the first bell, the teacher shows how to fold a fan. She folds the paper back and front. Each child makes a paper fan.
payload.title: Making a paper fan in class

payload.passage: Early in the day, Roshni keeps her water bottle in her bag. At break she drinks a big sip. Then she puts the cap back tight.
payload.title: Roshni drinks her water
decoys: The bottle is in her bag

payload.passage: Frogs live near a cool green pond. They can jump up very high and very far with their back legs. They catch buzzing flies with their long sticky tongue.
payload.title: Frogs live near the pond

payload.passage: On our birthday we wear funny pointy party hats. We blow loudly on a long noisy horn. We laugh and play happily with all our friends.
payload.title: We wear party hats on birthdays

payload.passage: After the first bell, the children draw their own family. Each one draws mother and father. They add their pets and friends too.
payload.title: Drawing my family in class

payload.passage: Honey is a sweet food that is golden in colour. Busy bees make it inside their buzzing hive. We love to spread it on warm bread and eat it.
payload.title: Honey is sweet and golden
decoys: Honey is made in a hive

payload.passage: A rainbow is an arch with many bright colours. It comes out in the sky after the rain has stopped. Red, yellow and blue all shine together up high.
payload.title: A rainbow has many colours

payload.passage: We meet our old friends again at festivals. We happily hug them and talk for many hours. It makes us feel so glad to see them.
payload.title: We meet old friends at festivals

payload.passage: Anjali's grandmother could not read the small letters in the newspaper. So every evening Anjali sat beside her and read the news aloud. Grandmother loved hearing about the city and the weather. The two of them spent a happy hour together each day.
payload.title: Anjali reads the newspaper to grandmother
decoys: Grandmother could not read small letters
They spent a happy hour together
Reading aloud is a very kind thing

payload.passage: Two friends had a skipping race in the school yard. They had to skip to the wall and back. Harini skipped fast without tripping on the rope. She reached the wall first and won.
payload.title: Harini wins the skipping race

payload.passage: A boy in the park could not blow up his football. The pump was too stiff for his small arms. An older girl pumped air into it for him. The boy ran off happily to play.
payload.title: A girl pumps air into the ball
decoys: A little help brings big joy

payload.passage: Two friends raced their spinning tops on the smooth floor. They wanted to see whose top spun longer. Yogesh threw his top with a strong wind-up. His top kept spinning the longest and won.
payload.title: Yogesh's top wins the spinning race
decoys: They raced on a smooth floor
A good throw wins the game

payload.passage: A heavy box of books had to be carried up to the top floor. One child alone could not lift it. So four friends each held a corner and lifted slowly. Together they carried the box up with ease.
payload.title: Four friends carry the heavy box together
decoys: The box was too heavy for one
Sharing a load makes it light

payload.passage: Sara loves to make tiny gardens inside glass jars. She layers small stones, soil, and a little plant. She sprays a few drops of water inside. Sara keeps her jar garden on her sunny windowsill.
payload.title: Sara Makes a Jar Garden
decoys: She keeps it on the sill.

payload.passage: The spice corner of the market smelled wonderful. There were bags of yellow turmeric, red chilli, and brown cinnamon. The seller scooped each spice with a little spoon. Mother bought what she needed for the week's cooking.
payload.title: The Spice Corner at the Market
decoys: There were bags of red chilli.
The seller used a little spoon.

payload.passage: Meera enjoys making masks out of paper plates. She cuts holes for the eyes and paints funny faces. She ties a string so the mask stays on. Meera and her friends wear the masks for their pretend plays.
payload.title: Meera Makes Paper Plate Masks

payload.passage: An old lady's spectacles broke right before her eye check. She could not see the doctor's chart at all. A helpful nurse lent her a spare pair of glasses. The lady completed her check with a smile.
payload.title: A nurse lends spare glasses to a lady

payload.passage: The school bus had a flat tyre on the way home. The children were worried they would be late. Some big boys helped the driver push the bus aside. They waited patiently while a new tyre was fixed.
payload.title: Boys help the driver with the flat tyre
decoys: The bus had a flat tyre
Helping in trouble shows good heart

payload.passage: An old woman dropped her walking stick near the bus stop. She could not bend down to pick it up. Vijay quickly picked up the stick and handed it back. The woman smiled and blessed the helpful boy.
payload.title: Vijay returns the old woman's stick

payload.passage: Aarav went to the zoo with his class. They saw lions, monkeys, and a tall giraffe. The teacher told them how each animal lives and what it eats. Aarav learned many new things about animals on this trip.
payload.title: A Class Trip to the Zoo
decoys: They saw monkeys at the zoo.

payload.passage: Ravi explored a museum about how houses were built long ago. He saw mud bricks, wooden beams, and old tools. A model showed a tiny village of small huts. Ravi learned that people once built homes by hand.
payload.title: How Old Houses Were Built

payload.passage: Diya likes to make soft toys from old cloth. She cuts the cloth and stuffs it with bits of wool. She sews button eyes and a smiling mouth. Diya has made a little bear and a floppy rabbit.
payload.title: Diya Makes Soft Toys

payload.passage: Two little children were stuck inside a locked car in the heat. They cried and banged on the window. A passing watchman called for help right away. The children were freed and given cool water.
payload.title: A watchman saves two trapped children

payload.passage: The museum had a room about space and the stars. Ananya saw models of planets hanging from the ceiling. A small film showed how rockets fly into space. She decided she wanted to learn much more about the sky.
payload.title: The Space Room at the Museum
decoys: Planet models hung from the ceiling.

payload.passage: Ishaan likes to fix old toys that are broken. He finds the loose parts and glues them back. Sometimes he uses tape or a small screw. Ishaan feels happy when a broken toy works once more.
payload.title: Ishaan Fixes Broken Toys

payload.passage: Ravi liked the flower seller at the market best. She had roses, marigolds, and bunches of soft white jasmine. She tied the flowers into pretty garlands with quick fingers. Ravi bought a small garland for his grandmother.
payload.title: The Flower Seller's Pretty Garlands

payload.passage: The old man's newspaper blew across the windy road. He could not run fast to catch it. A boy chased the paper and brought it back. The man folded it and thanked the boy.
payload.title: A boy catches the blown newspaper
decoys: The paper blew across the road
A small help is always nice

payload.passage: Anaya saw a hall full of beautiful old pots at the museum. The clay pots were painted with fine patterns. Some were tiny and some were taller than her. A board said people used them to store grain and water.
payload.title: Old Painted Pots at the Museum

payload.passage: A man fainted in the long queue at the bank. People around him did not know what to do. A young woman moved him to a chair and fanned him. She gave him water until he felt better.
payload.title: A woman helps a man who fainted
decoys: The man fainted in the queue
She fanned him with her hand

payload.passage: The boys played a friendly wrestling match on the soft grass. Vimal was smaller but very quick. He used his speed to slip out of every hold. In the end, he won and they shook hands.
payload.title: Quick Vimal wins the wrestling match
decoys: Speed can beat size in wrestling

payload.passage: During the exam, a boy's pen ran out of ink suddenly. He had no other pen in his bag. His neighbour quietly passed him a spare blue pen. The boy finished his paper on time.
payload.title: A boy lends a spare pen
decoys: His pen ran out of ink
He finished his paper on time

payload.passage: The high jump bar was set very high for the final jump. Many children failed to clear it. Pankaj took a long run, jumped, and flew right over the bar. He set a new record for his school.
payload.title: Pankaj sets a new high jump record
decoys: The bar was set very high
He took a long run before jumping
Jumping high needs lots of practice

payload.passage: An old lady stood at the busy road and was afraid to cross. The cars and bikes went past very fast. Yash gently held her arm and raised his hand to the traffic. He walked her safely to the other side.
payload.title: Yash helps an old lady cross the road
decoys: The cars went past very fast
He raised his hand to the traffic
Helping elders is a great duty

payload.passage: Tara visited the reptile pond and saw a huge crocodile. It floated very still with only its eyes above the water. Then suddenly it snapped its long jaws shut. Tara jumped back, surprised at how fast the big crocodile moved.
payload.title: The Big Crocodile at the Zoo

payload.passage: A girls' relay team kept dropping the baton in practice. They felt upset after every drop. Their coach taught them to pass it smoothly. On race day they passed it well and won.
payload.title: Smooth passing wins the girls' relay

payload.passage: Ananya saw a giant clock at the centre of the museum. Its hands were as long as a grown man's arm. A board said the clock was over a hundred years old. Ananya waited to hear it chime loudly on the hour.
payload.title: The Giant Clock at the Museum

payload.passage: There was a haunted house at the corner of the fair. Inside it was dark with spooky sounds and moving shapes. Ishaan held his friend's hand as they walked through. They came out shaking but laughing at how scared they had been.
payload.title: The Spooky Haunted House

payload.passage: Tanya and her grandfather love to play chess on Sundays. Grandfather has played for many years and is very clever. Tanya watches his moves and learns new tricks each time. Last week she finally won her first game.
payload.title: Tanya learns chess from her grandfather

payload.passage: Komal noticed an old man sitting alone on a park bench. He looked lonely and had no one to talk to. So Komal sat beside him and listened to his stories. The old man smiled and said she had made his day.
payload.title: Komal keeps a lonely old man company
decoys: Listening is a kind thing to do

payload.passage: Aditya loves to grow flowers from tiny seeds. He planted marigold seeds in a sunny patch of soil. He waters them and pulls out the weeds each day. Aditya was thrilled when the first orange flower opened.
payload.title: Aditya Grows Marigold Flowers

payload.passage: Tara enjoys making puppets dance on strings. She ties thread to a little wooden cross. The puppet moves its arms and legs when she pulls. Tara puts on small puppet shows for her family at night.
payload.title: Tara's String Puppet Shows
decoys: She ties thread to a cross.

payload.passage: Ravi was the youngest player in the football team. The bigger boys did not want to pass him the ball. But the coach told them to play as one team. When they finally passed to Ravi, he scored a goal.
payload.title: Teamwork helps young Ravi score
decoys: The coach told them to share
A team plays better as one

payload.passage: Aditya wanted to try the high swing ride at the fair. The swings flew out in a wide circle as they spun. Aditya felt the wind rush past his face. He shouted with joy as he swung high above the ground.
payload.title: The High Swing Ride
decoys: The swings flew in a circle.

payload.passage: The girls' team was new at hockey and lost many matches. They felt sad and wanted to stop playing. Their captain told them to practise harder together. After weeks of effort, they finally won a match.
payload.title: The hockey team practises and wins

payload.passage: A girl forgot her colours on drawing day at school. She sat with a blank, sad face. Her bench partner shared half of her colour box. Both girls drew bright pictures together.
payload.title: A girl shares her colour box

payload.passage: Veer enjoys growing beans on a wet cloth. He folds the cloth around a few bean seeds. He keeps it damp and waits a few days. Veer watches with joy as little roots and shoots appear.
payload.title: Veer Sprouts Beans on a Cloth
decoys: He folds beans in a cloth.

payload.passage: Riya started a stamp collection this year. She keeps her stamps neatly in a small album. Friends and family give her stamps from their old letters. Riya loves to look at the pictures from many far places.
payload.title: Riya's New Stamp Collection
decoys: She keeps them in an album.

payload.passage: The school had a fun penalty shootout to end sports day. Each child got one kick at the goal. Latha aimed at the corner and scored cleanly. Her goal won the shootout for her team.
payload.title: Latha scores in the penalty shootout
decoys: A good aim wins the shootout

payload.passage: Ravi's baby sister was crying loudly in her cot. Their mother was busy cooking in the kitchen. Ravi sat by the cot and sang a soft little song. Slowly the baby stopped crying and fell fast asleep.
payload.title: Ravi soothes his crying baby sister
decoys: The baby was crying loudly in her cot
Ravi sang a soft little song
Babies cry when they feel upset

payload.passage: Madhu noticed that the class fish tank was very dirty. The water had turned cloudy and green. She told the teacher and offered to clean it. Together they changed the water and the fish swam happily.
payload.title: Madhu helps clean the class fish tank
decoys: Caring for pets is a kind duty

payload.passage: Vikas was new to cricket and held the bat the wrong way. The older boys laughed at his weak shots. His coach showed him how to grip and swing the bat. Soon Vikas was hitting strong, clean shots.
payload.title: A coach teaches Vikas to bat properly
decoys: He held the bat the wrong way

payload.passage: On a hot summer day, a tired postman knocked at the gate. His face was red and dripping with sweat. Vivek ran inside and brought him a glass of cold water. The postman drank it and thanked the kind boy.
payload.title: Vivek offers cold water to the postman
decoys: The postman was dripping with sweat
Vivek brought a glass of water

payload.passage: Priya loves to make her own puppets dance to music. She moves the strings in time with the beat. She makes the puppet hop, twirl, and bow. Priya's puppet dance always brings a big cheer.
payload.title: Priya's Dancing Puppet Show
decoys: She moves the strings in time.

payload.passage: Ishaan enjoys making a calendar with his own drawings. He draws a picture for each month of the year. He adds the numbers in neat little boxes. Ishaan hangs his handmade calendar in the kitchen.
payload.title: Ishaan Makes a Drawing Calendar

payload.passage: The children gathered in the lane to play hide and seek. Govind was chosen to be the seeker first. He counted to twenty with his eyes shut tight. Then he ran and found everyone one by one.
payload.title: Govind plays hide and seek
decoys: Outdoor games are full of fun

payload.passage: The children made up a new game with a ball and a basket. They called it the basket toss and made simple rules. Everyone took turns to throw the ball into the basket. The one with the most baskets won the game.
payload.title: Children invent a fun basket toss game
decoys: New games can be lots of fun

payload.passage: Anaya loves to learn new songs on her toy keyboard. She presses the keys to find the right notes. She practises the same tune over and over. Anaya can now play a whole nursery song by herself.
payload.title: Anaya Learns the Toy Keyboard

payload.passage: Priya loved the monkeys best at the zoo. They jumped from branch to branch and hung by their tails. One cheeky monkey grabbed a banana and ran up the tree. Priya laughed so much that her cheeks began to hurt.
payload.title: Funny Monkeys Made Priya Laugh
decoys: The monkeys hung by their tails.

payload.passage: The street near Ananya's house was full of litter and plastic. It looked dirty and smelled bad in the heat. So Ananya gathered her friends and they cleaned it together. They filled three bags and made the street look fresh.
payload.title: Ananya and friends clean the street
decoys: The street was full of plastic
A clean place is good for all

payload.passage: Riya loves to make pom-poms out of soft wool. She winds the wool round and round her fingers. Then she ties the middle tight and snips the loops. Riya turns her fluffy pom-poms into little toy animals.
payload.title: Riya Makes Woollen Pom-Poms
decoys: She winds wool round her fingers.

payload.passage: The children had a hopping race in the school ground. Each player had to hop on one leg to the line. Bunty hopped steadily without putting his foot down. He reached first and won the funny race.
payload.title: Bunty wins the one-leg hopping race

payload.passage: Suresh was running in the relay race for his team. He gripped the baton tightly and waited for his turn. When his friend reached him, he grabbed the baton and sprinted. His team finished first because of his fast run.
payload.title: Suresh helps his team win the relay

payload.passage: The market had an old man who sold balloons. He held a huge bunch of red, yellow, and blue ones. Children gathered around him with happy faces. Vikram chose a big green balloon shaped like a star.
payload.title: The Balloon Seller at the Market
decoys: He held red and blue balloons.

payload.passage: The fair had a fun house full of curved mirrors. In one mirror Anaya looked very tall and thin. In another she looked short and round. She laughed at her funny shapes in the mirror room.
payload.title: The Funny Mirror Room
decoys: One mirror made her look tall.

payload.passage: The old vegetable seller could not count the change quickly. A long line was waiting at her cart. A schoolgirl helped her count and give the change. The line moved fast and people were happy.
payload.title: A girl helps the seller count change

payload.passage: A football was the only ball the children had to share. They took turns to play short matches with it. Everyone got a fair chance to kick and score. They played happily till it was time to go.
payload.title: Children share one football fairly
decoys: Sharing makes games fair and fun

payload.passage: It was a cold morning and a kitten sat shivering on the gate. Its fur was wet and it cried softly. Aarush brought a warm cloth and a saucer of milk. The kitten curled up warm and stopped crying.
payload.title: Aarush cares for a cold kitten
decoys: He brought a saucer of milk
Small animals need warmth and care

payload.passage: Anjali joined the lucky dip stall at the fair. She had to put her hand into a box full of toys. She could not see what she would pull out. Anjali squealed with joy when she found a tiny toy car.
payload.title: The Lucky Dip at the Fair
decoys: She put her hand in a box.

payload.passage: The school held a long-distance race around the park. Many children ran fast and got tired early. Vinay kept a slow, steady pace the whole way. He passed the tired runners and won the race.
payload.title: Steady Vinay wins the long race

payload.passage: Old Mrs. Iyer could not climb the steep stairs with her bag. She held the railing and rested halfway. Aniket took her bag and walked slowly beside her. He saw her safely to her door upstairs.
payload.title: Aniket helps Mrs. Iyer up the stairs
decoys: He saw her to her door

payload.passage: Vikram went to the market to get his cycle tyre fixed. The repair man found the small hole quickly. He patched it and pumped in fresh air. Vikram thanked him and rode his cycle home with a smile.
payload.title: Getting the Cycle Tyre Fixed
decoys: The man found a small hole.

payload.passage: The class library was in a big mess after the holidays. Books lay in piles on every shelf and table. Lakshmi offered to stay back and arrange them all. She sorted the books by size and made the shelves neat.
payload.title: Lakshmi tidies the messy class library
decoys: She sorted the books by size
A tidy room is a happy room

payload.passage: Vikram saw the hippo for the first time at the zoo. The big animal stayed in the water with only its eyes showing. When it opened its huge mouth, everyone gasped. Vikram learned that hippos love to spend the day in water.
payload.title: The Hippo Loves the Water
decoys: The hippo opened its huge mouth.
The zoo is a fun place.

payload.passage: During lunch, Salim saw a boy with no spoon for his rice. The boy did not know what to do. Salim quickly gave the boy his own spare spoon. The boy smiled and ate his lunch happily.
payload.title: Salim shares his spare spoon

payload.passage: Aarav loves to build cities out of building blocks. He stacks tall towers and wide bridges. He makes roads with little block cars on them. Aarav spends whole afternoons building his block city.
payload.title: Aarav Builds a Block City

payload.passage: Ananya helped at her uncle's vegetable stall on Sunday. She arranged the tomatoes in a neat red pile. She handed bags to the customers with a smile. Ananya felt grown-up helping her uncle at the busy market.
payload.title: Ananya Helps at the Stall

payload.passage: Kabir watched a bangle seller fit bangles onto a lady's wrist. The seller knew exactly which size would slip on. The glass bangles made a soft clinking sound. Kabir thought it was clever how the seller never broke even one.
payload.title: The Skilled Bangle Seller

payload.passage: The children had a sack race at the school fair. Each child stood inside a big jute sack. They had to hop forward without falling down. Bittu hopped the fastest and reached the finish first.
payload.title: Bittu wins the sack race
decoys: Each child stood in a sack
Fair games bring lots of joy

payload.passage: The children played a fun shadow tag in the evening sun. One had to step on another's shadow to tag. Sahana kept her shadow away from the chaser. She stayed safe and won the game.
payload.title: Sahana wins the shadow tag game

payload.passage: Sara loves to make her own bookmarks. She cuts strips of card and draws fun pictures on them. She tapes a small ribbon to the top of each one. Sara gives her best bookmarks to friends who love reading.
payload.title: Sara Makes Her Own Bookmarks
decoys: She tapes a ribbon on top.

payload.passage: Priya helped her mother carry the shopping list at the market. She read out each item one by one. They found the tea, the soap, and the biscuits. Priya was happy that nothing on the list was forgotten.
payload.title: Following the Shopping List

payload.passage: Vikram saw a real old car at the car museum. Its body was shiny black with round headlamps. A board said it was one of the first cars ever made. Vikram peeked inside at the big wooden steering wheel.
payload.title: An Old Car at the Museum

payload.passage: A poor student had no umbrella during the rainy season. He got wet every day on his way to school. His classmate brought him an old raincoat from home. The boy stayed dry and felt very thankful.
payload.title: A boy gives away his raincoat

payload.passage: Riya went to the beach with her family for the day. They spread a mat on the soft, warm sand. Riya built a tall sandcastle while her brother swam. It was a happy day full of sun, sand, and sea.
payload.title: A Family Day at the Beach
decoys: They spread a mat on the sand.

payload.passage: A spinning top game was played by the village boys. Each tried to spin his top the longest. Hari wound his string tight and threw it down hard. His top spun the longest and he won the round.
payload.title: Hari's top spins the longest
decoys: Top spinning is an old game

payload.passage: Vikram visited a museum about trains. He saw a real old steam engine, black and shining. A guide showed how coal was once used to make it run. Vikram climbed up to peek inside the driver's cabin.
payload.title: The Steam Engine at the Museum

payload.passage: Rohan went paddling in the shallow water at the beach. He rolled up his shorts and walked in slowly. Tiny fish darted around his feet in the clear water. Rohan tried to catch one but they were far too quick.
payload.title: Paddling in the Shallow Water
decoys: The sea is full of fish.

payload.passage: As the sun set, the whole beach turned golden. The sky filled with orange, pink, and red colours. The sea sparkled as the light danced on the waves. Diya thought the beach sunset was the prettiest thing she had ever seen.
payload.title: A Beautiful Sunset at the Beach
decoys: The sky turned orange and pink.
The sea sparkled in the light.
The beach is by the sea.

payload.passage: Aditya enjoys making maps of his own neighbourhood. He draws the roads, his school, and the park. He marks his house with a big red dot. Aditya pins his map proudly on his bedroom wall.
payload.title: Aditya Maps His Neighbourhood
decoys: He draws the roads and park.
He marks his house in red.

payload.passage: A man at the fair could guess your weight. People stood on his scale while he made a clever guess. If he got it wrong, you won a small toy. Meera giggled when the man guessed her weight almost right.
payload.title: The Weight-Guessing Game at the Fair
decoys: A wrong guess won a toy.

payload.passage: The children played a game of catch the ball in pairs. They stood far apart and threw it to and fro. Govind never dropped the ball even once. His partner said he had the safest hands.
payload.title: Govind never drops the ball

payload.passage: The class hamster's cage was getting dirty and smelly. No one wanted to clean it. But Pooja put on gloves and changed the bedding. She gave the hamster fresh food and clean water.
payload.title: Pooja cleans the class hamster's cage

payload.passage: An old lady's heavy shopping bag tore open in the market. Fruits and packets fell onto the dusty ground. Some children gathered them and found a new bag. They filled the bag and walked her home.
payload.title: Children help a lady with her torn bag
decoys: Helping in the market is kind

payload.passage: A small boy in the bus was scared of the loud thunder. He hid his face and started to cry. Sumit sat next to him and told him a funny story. The boy laughed and forgot all about the storm.
payload.title: Sumit comforts a scared little boy
decoys: The boy was scared of thunder
Sumit told him a funny story
A friend can chase away fear

payload.passage: Rohan enjoys building robots from spare parts. He joins old caps, wires, and small boxes together. He drew big eyes and a smiling mouth on his robot. Rohan named his little robot and put it on his desk.
payload.title: Rohan Builds a Toy Robot
decoys: He used old caps and wires.

payload.passage: A coconut seller sat under a tree at the beach. He chopped the top off each coconut with a sharp knife. People drank the sweet water through a straw. Aditya enjoyed his coconut while resting in the cool shade.
payload.title: The Coconut Seller at the Beach

payload.passage: Aditya tried the fishing game at the fair. He used a stick with a magnet to catch toy fish. Each fish had a number for a different prize. Aditya caught a fish with a star and won a balloon.
payload.title: The Magnet Fishing Game

payload.passage: Two boys raced their toy cars down a sloping board. They let the cars go at the same time. Lalit's car rolled smooth and straight to the end. It reached the bottom first and won the race.
payload.title: Lalit's toy car wins the race

payload.passage: The school held a fun frog jump race on the grass. Children squatted and jumped like little frogs. Yogesh jumped far with each strong leap. He reached the line first and won.
payload.title: Yogesh wins the frog jump race

payload.passage: A swimming relay was held at the school pool. Each swimmer had to finish their lap fast. Harini swam her lap quicker than the rest. Her speed helped her team win the relay.
payload.title: Harini's speed wins the swimming relay
decoys: She swam quicker than the rest

payload.passage: Tara and her family had a picnic right on the beach. They ate sandwiches, fruit, and cold juice on a mat. Seagulls flew close, hoping for a few crumbs. The picnic by the sea was the best part of the trip.
payload.title: A Picnic on the Beach

payload.passage: Meera enjoys making collages from old magazines. She cuts out colourful pictures and bits of paper. She arranges them and glues them into a scene. Meera made a bright collage of a busy city for her wall.
payload.title: Meera Makes Paper Collages

payload.passage: Meera visited a museum that showed how books were made. She saw old paper, ink pots, and metal letters. A guide showed how pages were once pressed by hand. Meera was glad that books are easy to make today.
payload.title: How Books Were Made Long Ago

payload.passage: Ananya rode the small roller coaster at the fair. The little train zoomed up and down the bumpy track. Her tummy felt funny on the steep drops. Ananya screamed and laughed at the very same time.
payload.title: The Small Roller Coaster Ride
decoys: The train zoomed up and down.

payload.passage: The class played a fun number guessing game in two teams. One team picked a number and gave clues. Sahana's team guessed it in the fewest tries. They won the round and cheered loudly.
payload.title: Sahana's team wins the guessing game

payload.passage: Sanjay is the goalkeeper for his school football team. He stands tall and watches the ball very closely. When the other team kicked hard at the goal, he jumped and saved it. His team cheered for the great save.
payload.title: Sanjay makes a great goal-saving jump

payload.passage: There was a treasure hunt game in the big garden. The children read clues to find the hidden box. Sonal solved the tricky clues one by one. She found the treasure box under the mango tree.
payload.title: Sonal wins the garden treasure hunt
decoys: She found the box under a tree

payload.passage: The boys played a long game of pakdam pakdai in the lane. One boy had to chase and tag the others. Naresh was quick and dodged every grab. He stayed free till the end and won.
payload.title: Naresh dodges and wins the chasing game
decoys: One boy had to tag others
Being quick helps in chasing games

payload.passage: The school garden taps were left running by mistake. Clean water was spilling onto the path. Naresh saw this and closed every tap tightly. He saved a lot of water that day.
payload.title: Naresh saves water at school

payload.passage: The museum had a hall full of beautiful old jewellery. There were gold necklaces, silver rings, and shining stones. Each piece sat safely behind thick glass. Sneha thought the kings and queens of long ago must have worn them.
payload.title: Old Jewellery at the Museum

payload.passage: Priya loves to make her own scented soaps. With help, she melts a soap base and adds rose petals. She pours it into little moulds to set. Priya gives her pretty soaps as gifts to her family.
payload.title: Priya Makes Scented Soaps

payload.passage: Ananya enjoys making paper lanterns. She folds and cuts the paper into a fine pattern. Then she rolls it into a round shape and glues the ends. Ananya hangs her bright lanterns up for festivals.
payload.title: Ananya Makes Paper Lanterns

payload.passage: Veer enjoys making spinning tops out of old buttons. He pushes a small stick through the button hole. Then he gives it a quick twist to make it spin. Veer has a race to see whose top spins the longest.
payload.title: Veer Makes Spinning Tops

payload.passage: A boy saw a frog struggling in a deep, slippery drain. It could not jump out of the smooth walls. He lowered a long stick into the drain gently. The frog climbed the stick and hopped to safety.
payload.title: A boy rescues a frog from the drain
decoys: The frog could not jump out

payload.passage: Mohit was very good at solving puzzles. His sister gave him a hard jigsaw with many pieces. He worked on it quietly for the whole afternoon. By evening he had joined every piece and finished it.
payload.title: Mohit finishes the hard jigsaw puzzle

payload.passage: Karan has a hobby of building with blocks. He stacks them into houses, bridges, and tall towers. Sometimes his towers fall, but he just builds again. Karan loves making new things with his colourful blocks.
payload.title: Karan Builds with Blocks

payload.passage: Ananya loves to make her own kite from a plastic bag. She cuts the bag and tapes on two thin sticks. She ties on a tail and a long flying string. Ananya runs across the field to lift her light kite up.
payload.title: Ananya Makes a Bag Kite

payload.passage: Sara saw the gorillas sitting calmly behind the glass. The big gorilla rested while a baby played near its feet. A board said gorillas are gentle and live in family groups. Sara watched the quiet family for a long, happy while.
payload.title: The Gorilla Family at the Zoo
decoys: A baby played near its feet.

payload.passage: Tara enjoys making bead jewellery in her free time. She threads bright beads onto a long string. She has made necklaces and bracelets in many colours. Tara loves giving her bead jewellery to her best friends.
payload.title: Tara Makes Bead Jewellery
decoys: She threads beads on a string.

payload.passage: Anjali watched the seagulls glide above the beach. The white birds swooped down to grab bits of food. One bold gull snatched a chip right from a plate. Anjali laughed but held her own snack a little tighter.
payload.title: Seagulls at the Beach

payload.passage: Rohan saw a big model of an old town at the museum. Tiny houses, streets, and shops filled the table. Little lights lit up the windows of the model. Rohan bent close to spot the tiny people inside.
payload.title: The Old Town Model at the Museum

payload.passage: An old man dropped his bunch of keys down a deep step. He could not bend low to reach them. A boy named Yogesh climbed down and picked them up. He placed the keys back in the man's hand.
payload.title: Yogesh returns the old man's keys
decoys: The keys fell down a step

payload.passage: During the picnic, a boy dropped his food on the grass. He had nothing left to eat and looked upset. Three friends each shared a bit of their own food. Soon the boy had a full plate and a big smile.
payload.title: Friends share food with a sad boy
decoys: He had a full plate again

payload.passage: Priya found a small room about old games at the museum. There were dice, marbles, and carved wooden boards. A guide showed how children played a board game long ago. Priya tried the old game and found it great fun.
payload.title: Old Games at the Museum

payload.passage: Mr. Sharma's gate was stuck and would not open. He pushed and pulled but it was too heavy. Two children passing by came and pushed it together. The gate finally opened and Mr. Sharma thanked them.
payload.title: Children help open the stuck gate
decoys: A little help goes a long way

payload.passage: Anjali loves to make her own bookmarks from pressed flowers. She sticks a dried flower onto a card strip. She covers it with clear tape to keep it safe. Anjali uses her flower bookmark in her storybook.
payload.title: Anjali Makes Flower Bookmarks

payload.passage: Ravi watched the kangaroos hop around their grassy field at the zoo. They jumped on their strong back legs and balanced with their tails. One mother kangaroo had a baby peeking out from her pouch. Ravi thought the bouncing animals were the funniest of all.
payload.title: Kangaroos Hop at the Zoo
decoys: A baby peeked from the pouch.

payload.passage: Anaya helped clean up rubbish on the beach with her class. They picked up plastic bottles and old bags. They put everything into big black sacks. Anaya felt proud to keep the lovely beach clean.
payload.title: Cleaning Up the Beach

payload.passage: The classroom dustbin was full and overflowing. Bits of paper spilled onto the floor. Without being told, Rakesh emptied the bin outside. Then he swept up the paper to keep the room clean.
payload.title: Rakesh keeps the classroom clean
decoys: A clean room is everyone's job

payload.passage: A little girl could not climb onto the high swing. She tried and tried but kept slipping down. Her brother lifted her up gently onto the seat. He pushed the swing slowly while she laughed.
payload.title: A brother helps his sister onto the swing

payload.passage: Grandfather's slippers were left out in the rain by mistake. They were soaked and could not be worn. Little Manya dried them with a soft cloth. She placed them neatly by his bed.
payload.title: Manya dries grandfather's wet slippers

payload.passage: Every morning Meera helps her mother in the kitchen. She washes the small cups and lays the plates on the table. Her mother says the work finishes faster with two hands. Meera feels proud to be a good helper at home.
payload.title: Meera helps her mother every morning
decoys: The work finishes faster with two hands
Children should always be helpful and kind

payload.passage: A village cricket match went down to the last ball. Two runs were needed for the win. Naresh tapped the ball and ran very fast. He made the two runs and won the match.
payload.title: Naresh runs hard to win the match
decoys: Quick running can win a match

payload.passage: Vikram enjoys building roller tracks for his toy balls. He bends thick card into long curving paths. He props them up so the balls roll fast. Vikram loves the rattle as a ball zooms to the bottom.
payload.title: Vikram Builds Ball Roller Tracks

payload.passage: Old Mr. Rao next door dropped his bag of vegetables on the road. The onions and tomatoes rolled everywhere. Aarav rushed out and picked up every single one. Mr. Rao thanked him warmly and called him a kind boy.
payload.title: Aarav helps a neighbour pick up vegetables
decoys: The onions rolled everywhere on the road
Mr. Rao called him a kind boy
Neighbours should always help each other

payload.passage: Sneha likes to make her own greeting stamps. She carves simple shapes into a cut potato. She dips them in paint and presses them on paper. Sneha decorates her letters with her bright potato stamps.
payload.title: Sneha Makes Potato Stamps

payload.passage: Sara enjoys making wind chimes from old keys and shells. She ties them to a stick with bits of string. When the breeze blows, they make a soft jingle. Sara hung her wind chime by the kitchen window.
payload.title: Sara Makes a Wind Chime
decoys: She used old keys and shells.
She hung it by the window.

payload.passage: A little girl could not open her heavy school gate alone. She pushed with all her tiny strength. A kind senior boy opened it wide for her. She walked in and thanked him sweetly.
payload.title: A senior boy opens the gate
decoys: Older students can help the young

payload.passage: The giant wheel was the tallest ride at the fair. Veer sat in a swinging seat as it slowly went up. From the top he could see the whole bright fairground. The view from the giant wheel took his breath away.
payload.title: Riding the Giant Wheel
decoys: The seat swung as it rose.

payload.passage: Ishaan enjoys learning simple knots with a piece of rope. His grandfather shows him a new knot each week. He practises until his fingers know the way. Ishaan can now tie a strong knot all by himself.
payload.title: Ishaan Learns to Tie Knots

payload.passage: The whole class was making a card for their sick teacher. Some children could not draw very well. The good artists helped the others with their pictures. Together they made the loveliest card ever.
payload.title: Students make a card for their sick teacher
decoys: Some children could not draw well

payload.passage: A boy on crutches could not carry his lunch tray. He stood waiting and looked unsure. His friend picked up the tray and carried it for him. They sat together and ate their lunch.
payload.title: A friend carries the lunch tray
decoys: Helping friends is a kind habit

payload.passage: On her birthday, Maya got a big box of new colours. Her cousin had only a few broken crayons left. Maya split the new colours and gave half to her cousin. Her cousin hugged her and they coloured a picture together.
payload.title: Maya shares her birthday colours
decoys: Maya got a big box of colours
Birthdays are a time for joy

payload.passage: Kho-kho is a fast game played in two teams. Payal sat in the line and waited for her chance to chase. When her turn came, she ran and tagged the runner quickly. Her speed helped her team win the match.
payload.title: Payal's speed helps win the kho-kho match
decoys: She sat in the line first

payload.passage: Veer tried his luck at the dart game at the fair. He had to pop balloons stuck on a board with darts. He popped two but missed the last one. The man still gave him a small whistle as a prize.
payload.title: Veer's Turn at the Dart Game

payload.passage: Tara loves to make her own paper flowers. She cuts petals from coloured paper and curls them. She glues them around a green paper stem. Tara fills a vase with her bright paper flowers.
payload.title: Tara Makes Paper Flowers
decoys: She fills a vase with them.

payload.passage: A girl in the bus could not find a seat and felt tired. She had a heavy bag on her shoulders. A boy stood up and offered her his seat. She sat down and thanked him with a smile.
payload.title: A boy gives up his seat
decoys: She thanked him with a smile
Offering a seat shows good manners

payload.passage: The classroom was being decorated for the annual day show. There was a lot of work and very little time. So every student took one small job to do. With everyone helping, the room was ready in an hour.
payload.title: Students decorate the class as a team

payload.passage: An old beggar woman shivered in the cold winter morning. She had no blanket to keep warm. A kind family gave her a thick shawl from home. She wrapped it around herself and felt warm.
payload.title: A family gives a warm shawl
decoys: She wrapped the shawl around herself
Helping the poor warms the heart

payload.passage: The vegetable seller gave Ishaan a free curry leaf bunch. He said good customers always get a little extra. Ishaan thanked him and put it in the basket. His mother said the kind seller was their favourite at the market.
payload.title: A Kind Seller at the Market
decoys: Ishaan put it in the basket.
He gave a free curry leaf bunch.

payload.passage: Kabir saw a stall full of bright clay toys. There were tiny animals, carts, and little dolls. The toy maker painted each one with great care. Kabir chose a small clay elephant to take home.
payload.title: Clay Toys at the Fair Stall
decoys: The toy maker painted each toy.

payload.passage: On sports day, Lata lined up for the hundred metre race. The whistle blew and all the girls dashed off. Lata ran as fast as she could without looking back. She crossed the line first and won a shiny medal.
payload.title: Lata wins the hundred metre race

payload.passage: Reema was nervous before her first swimming race. Her heart beat fast as she stood at the edge. She remembered her coach's words and dived in bravely. She finished the race and felt very proud.
payload.title: Reema bravely finishes her first race

payload.passage: A girl in class spilled water all over her drawing. She had worked hard and now looked sad. Her friends quickly gave her fresh paper and crayons. She drew a new picture even better than before.
payload.title: Friends help a girl after a spill
decoys: She spilled water on her drawing
Friends turn a bad day good

payload.passage: Grandmother's wool got tangled into a big knot. She could not knit until it was sorted out. Little Toya sat for an hour and untangled the wool. Grandmother smiled and started her knitting again.
payload.title: Toya untangles grandmother's wool
decoys: The wool was in a big knot

payload.passage: Naveen badly wanted to win the chess game against Rishi. He saw a chance to move a piece while Rishi looked away. But he stopped himself and played the fair way. Even though he lost, he felt good inside.
payload.title: Naveen plays chess fairly and honestly

payload.passage: The market had a stall full of clay pots and lamps. Kabir watched the potter shape wet clay on his wheel. The finished pots were left in the sun to dry. Kabir's mother bought two small pots for their plants.
payload.title: The Clay Pot Stall at the Market

payload.passage: Diya loves to make little lanterns out of paper cups. She cuts slits down the sides of each cup. A small light inside makes the slits glow. Diya lines up her glowing cup lanterns along the shelf.
payload.title: Diya Makes Paper Cup Lanterns
decoys: She cuts slits in the cups.

payload.passage: Ishaan likes to draw maps of made-up places. He adds rivers, hills, and little towns. He gives each place a funny name of his own. Ishaan dreams of one day visiting the lands he draws.
payload.title: Ishaan Draws Made-Up Maps

payload.passage: The school held a fun limbo game at the annual party. Children bent backward under a low bar. Manya bent very low and passed without falling. She cleared the lowest bar and won.
payload.title: Manya wins the limbo game
decoys: They bent under a low bar

payload.passage: Priya likes to make things from soft clay. She rolls, pinches, and shapes it into little animals. Last week she made a tiny clay turtle and a snail. Priya lines up all her clay animals on her shelf.
payload.title: Priya Makes Clay Animals
decoys: She keeps them on a shelf.

payload.passage: The zoo had a small farm corner for young children. There were goats, rabbits, and a few clucking hens. Karan brushed a friendly goat and fed it fresh leaves. He liked that he could touch and help the gentle farm animals.
payload.title: The Petting Farm at the Zoo

payload.passage: Ravi visited a museum filled with old toys. There were wooden dolls, tin cars, and spinning tops. A board said children played with these toys long ago. Ravi thought it was funny how toys had changed over time.
payload.title: Old Toys at the Museum

payload.passage: The children played a tongue twister game during break. They had to say a funny line very fast. Megha said the tricky line without a single mistake. Everyone laughed and clapped for her win.
payload.title: Megha wins the tongue twister game

payload.passage: A tug of war was held between two teams on sports day. Each team pulled the thick rope with all their strength. Both sides grunted and dug their heels into the ground. At last, the blue team pulled the red team over the line.
payload.title: The blue team wins the tug of war
decoys: Both teams pulled the rope hard

payload.passage: The newspaper man fell off his bicycle on the wet road. His papers scattered all over the ground. A boy and his sister rushed to gather them up. They helped him stack the papers and ride on.
payload.title: Children help the fallen newspaper man

payload.passage: Anjali went to the market to buy fresh curd and milk. The dairy seller poured the milk into her steel can. He wrapped the curd in a clean leaf-lined box. Anjali carried them home carefully so nothing would spill.
payload.title: Buying Milk and Curd
decoys: He poured milk into a can.

payload.passage: Meera enjoys making puppets from old socks. She sews on button eyes and woollen hair. Then she puts on little shows for her younger brother. Meera's sock puppets always make her brother laugh out loud.

decoys: She does shows for her brother.

payload.passage: At the beach, a man sold roasted corn from a small cart. He fanned the coals to keep them hot. The smell made everyone feel hungry. Anjali and her father shared a hot corn while watching the sea.

decoys: Anjali shared corn with her father.

payload.title: Tanvi gives old books to poor children

payload.passage: Manya was afraid to bat against the fast bowler. The hard ball came at her very quickly. She practised facing fast throws every day. Soon she hit the fast balls with ease.
payload.title: Manya learns to face fast bowling

payload.passage: Sneha watched a juggler at the fair throw balls in the air. He kept five balls spinning without dropping any. Then he juggled bright rings and even a hat. Sneha was amazed that his hands moved so fast.

payload.passage: Ananya enjoys making her own greeting beads. She rolls bits of coloured paper into tight tubes. She glues them and threads them onto string. Ananya wears the paper beads she made herself.
payload.title: Ananya Makes Paper Beads

payload.passage: A new girl could not understand the rules of the playground game. She stood at the side feeling left out. Two friends called her over and taught her the rules. Soon she was playing and laughing with everyone.

payload.passage: A blind man was walking with his stick on the footpath. A pile of bricks lay right in his path. Aryan quickly warned him and guided him around the bricks. The man thanked Aryan and walked on safely.

The man walked with a stick
We must help those who cannot see

decoys: A penguin slid on its tummy.
Penguins live in a cold place.

payload.passage: Ananya rode a camel along the beach with her father. The tall camel swayed gently as it walked. She could see far out over the blue sea. Ananya laughed every time the camel took a big step.

payload.title: Pradeep warns others about the wet floor
decoys: He put up a warning sign
Keeping others safe is a kind act

Her coach taught her to float
